_doc: Fault sets of the fault-injection soak (docs/probes/faultsoak-design-2026-11-26.md). Used through scenario.faults or `d2scenario soak --faults SET`. Keys: internal/faultproxy.Spec. Rates are in time (ms between injections of one kind), not in commands: the bot sends about ten reads per snapshot, so the first sets (a held reply every 40 commands, 20 s each) left it waiting most of the time and the 2026-11-26 soak rows stopped on the watchdog (card faultstall). delay_reply_ms is above the bot's 20 s command timeout so a held reply is a timeout for the bot. cancel_line is the game's own cancel verb: U, unverified until a lab run (the proxy only sends the line).
